objective: Audit the 2026-W46 downside miss, source time, lag, warning severity, price range and risk-to-action translation, with independent Grok/Fable review and a separately gated ONE-SHOT Sol MAX cross-exam. No trading or new production model.

lanes.name: Original PIT timeline and availability
lanes.question: Which exact original issue, source capture, published delivery and accepted warning existed before each market candle?
lanes.hypothesis: Missing first-known clocks and stale source exposure explain a material share of unusable warnings.
lanes.baseline: Direct native frozen issuance records and observed completed hourly bars; UNKNOWN as abstention.
lanes.falsifier: Complete verified early warnings survive corrected provenance and coverage is sufficient.

lanes.name: Warning severity versus actual action translation
lanes.question: Did a verified ELEVATED state ever escalate to HIGH or CONFIRMED, and which existing producer or gate prevented it?
lanes.hypothesis: The CN protection projection is inherited by the Official Compass without price-breach-driven escalation.
lanes.baseline: Unchanged ELEVATED 3/5 and constant HOLD vs verified state-machine episode controls.
lanes.falsifier: Producer independently emits correctly timed HIGH or prospective replay shows no relevant lead-time gain.

lanes.name: Point-in-time bearish range and tail stress
lanes.question: Would preknown simple volatility bands and equal-width price-only benchmarks have given more truthful downside intervals before the Friday shock?
lanes.hypothesis: The W46 deterministic expected-close path was too centered and too narrow despite bearish regime evidence.
lanes.baseline: Frozen CN vs width-equated first-known control, close-only, no-change, simple EWMA or ATR if preknown.
lanes.falsifier: Candidate fails on matched time, W39-W45 clustered weeks, postissuance leakage, or future untouched W47+ holdout.

lanes.name: Grok independent catalyst and fragility red team
lanes.question: What legally first-known public liquidity, flow, leverage, breadth and news features preceded the visible downside, and what are negative controls?
lanes.hypothesis: At most a small subset adds lead time beyond price/volatility after all source and publication lags.
lanes.baseline: Price-only and nominally contemporaneous public signals; matched quiet weeks and shuffled source timestamps.
lanes.falsifier: No eligible original clock, concentrated rumor source, post-event narrative or no incremental discrimination.
lanes.source_ref: Existing Grok Bridge #186 advisory lane, public-source only and no X read expansion without source authority

lanes.name: Sol 6.1 MAX source-bounded adversarial synthesis
lanes.question: Which smallest existing-owner model repair, if any, changes pre-shock warning utility after comparing all PIT features and simple baselines?
lanes.hypothesis: A source integrity plus risk escalation audit outperforms speculative multi-indicator fusion in marginal value.
lanes.baseline: Current KOMPAS2 active Sol mission and prior ARP01/ARP04 MAX plus no-change price-only controls.
lanes.falsifier: No distinct material question, pending active queue, budget fail, unavailable public PIT or zero incremental utility.
lanes.source_ref: Research Lab Sol original #1156/#1476 gate and current ACTIVE_RELEASED KOMPAS2 mission

lanes.name: Fable 5.2 blind independent methodological audit
lanes.question: Can an independent reviewer falsify source cuts, warning transition evidence, market usefulness and competing explanations?
lanes.hypothesis: An adversarial audit finds clock or falsifier errors before any claimed model improvement is accepted.
lanes.baseline: Claude full-CN W39-W45 equality-width and #1596 first-known audits; identical frozen source references.
lanes.falsifier: Independently reproduced controls agree and no surviving incremental edge claim appears.
lanes.source_ref: Existing Claude Bridge #173 Fable 5.2 review channel, no model run assumed

lanes.name: Deterministic evidence-bound cross-model adjudication
lanes.question: Where do Grok and Sol disagree on the same claim and source and does Fable replicate or falsify the dispute?
lanes.hypothesis: Hash-bound claims expose source-clock disagreements and unsupported model-consensus claims.
lanes.baseline: Literal report-byte SHA256 checks, claim-ID identity, unchanged source SHA and independent baseline rows.
lanes.falsifier: Any missing model receipt, mutated source, insufficient evidence or incompatible claims yields PENDING or DISAGREEMENT, never verified edge.
